scope: Explicit composed-visible-text-v3 production integration; regression evidence, not a model task score
problem: Hydrated public MDN pages exhausted the V2 text traversal budget on comments, trim-empty text and descendants already excluded by the visibility predicate.

change.derivation: Exactly the successfully tested generic H02 pruning prototype with its explicit production profile ID.
change.behavior: Skip excluded descendants and filter comments and trim-empty text children before reverse push. Retain nonempty text order and spacing, native action discovery, native execution and the existing numeric limits.
change.count_scope: The node counter applies after pruning. It is not a hard bound on all DOM reads, child-list creation, CSS checks or elapsed time.
change.compatibility: Native remains the default. Explicit V2 retains its original snapshot bytes. V4 admits only V2; V5 authenticates either explicit V2 or V3. V3 collection requires --allow-no-input-stale-scroll.
